attributes.residual: STRUCTURAL at three sites, so NOT WebFrank-eligible - the queue's premise is FALSIFIED against current output. The candidate was flagged by its discoverer as 'identical instructions AND schedule, recolor stage only'. It is not. Twelve words differ; nine are register fields consistent with the claimed callee-saved cycle, but THREE carry immediate differences that no guard may copy: at +0x5d4, +0x63c and +0x69c retail folds the field displacement onto the already-live base (stw r0,1068(r31) / stw r0,1140(r31) / stw r0,1152(r31)) while we materialize three dedicated pointer registers and store at displacement zero (stw r0,0(r23) / 0(r20) / 0(r19)). The displacement is a real instruction bit, not an allocator colour, and apply_patch rejects it exactly as it should: 'non-register instruction bits differ at +0x5d4: 0x0008042c'. DO-NOT-RETRY as a postprocessor candidate. The remaining nine register-field differences are very likely a CONSEQUENCE of the three extra live pointers inflating pressure, so they should not be counted as an independent recolor either - fix the addressing and re-measure before assuming any residual survives. NEXT ACTION belongs to a source lane, not this one: drop the three single-use base locals so the displacement folds, subject to the sfx.c pin constraint above.
